subject: Next Steps: prototype walkthrough — choose a window & confirm attendee roster
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@healthsync.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Next Steps: prototype walkthrough — choose a window & confirm attendee roster

Hi Sam / Julia,

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand HealthSync's prototype goals and the constraints around latency and on-prem data controls. Quick recap:
- Primary goal: validate a prototype inference flow for anonymized clinical notes (100–400 tokens typical) with predictable p99 latency <120ms.
- Success criteria for the pilot: throughput for 10 concurrent sessions, integration with your VPC connector, and a short mutual action plan for the first 30 days.

Next step: run a 45–60 minute prototype walkthrough (demo + architecture Q&A). Can you pick one of these windows?
1) Tue Sep 22 — 10:00–11:00 PT
2) Wed Sep 23 — 14:00–15:00 PT

Please confirm which works and send the final attendee list so we can create the invite with the right access (we often include an ops contact and a security reviewer). I’ve CC'd Monica (Customer Success) and Karthik (Solutions Engineer) to support the runbook and technical deep-dive.

I’ve attached a draft MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (high level) and a demo runbook stub — will iterate after we lock time. If you prefer Zoom instead of Google Meet, say the word and I’ll switch the invite.

Thanks —
Marcus
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (attachment), Demo-Runbook-v0.3.docx (attachment)

From: Sam Wu <sam.wu@healthsync.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@healthsync.io>
Date: 2026-09-18T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next Steps: prototype walkthrough — choose a window & confirm attendee roster

Thanks Marcus — great summary.

We’ll take slot #2 (Wed Sep 23 14:00–15:00 PT). Attendees from our side:
- Sam Wu (Product lead)
- Julia Park (Security reviewer)
- Diego Morales (Platform engineer, will join if available)

Zoom would be preferred because our security team annotates recordings to our internal QMS; if you can send a Zoom bridge that’d be ideal. Also, could you attach a short SOC2 checklist or linkage to the security questionnaire we filled earlier? Julia asked for that to prep.

Thanks,
Sam

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@healthsync.io>
Date: 2026-09-18T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next Steps: prototype walkthrough — choose a window & confirm attendee roster

Perfect — Wed Sep 23 14:00–15:00 PT is locked on our side. I created a provisional calendar event and included a Zoom bridge per your preference. Below are the links and a short agenda. Please confirm final attendees so we can add any join instructions for Diego or others.

Google Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-prototype-1
Zoom bridge: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abc123

Agenda (45–60 min):
- 10 min: quick goals recap & success criteria
- 20–25 min: prototype walkthrough (runtime, routing, KV cache behavior)
- 15 min: integration and security Q&A (VPC, KMS, audit logs)
- 5–10 min: next steps & action items (MVP scope, timelines)

Attachments: I’ve attached an updated MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf and Demo-Runbook-v0.3.docx. Also adding a short SOC2 checklist link we discussed: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/security/soc2-checklist (internal link — I'll export a PDF for you if needed).

If Diego needs any network prep (eg. allowlist IPs) please share the email for your infra lead and Karthik will send a short connectivity checklist.

See you Wed —
Marcus

Attachments: MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (attachment), Demo-Runbook-v0.3.docx (attachment)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Wu <sam.wu@healthsync.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@healthsync.io>
Date: 2026-09-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next Steps: prototype walkthrough — choose a window & confirm attendee roster

Thanks all — I updated the demo runbook with a short ops checklist and will own the session flow on Wed.

Sam: noted that Diego may be optional; if he joins please have him bring the VPC contact. I’ll also attach a one-page connectivity checklist to the calendar invite (IP allowlist + port notes).

Karthik: can you include two quick slides on the KV cache behavior and how we recommend configuring batching for HealthSync's token distribution? I’ll coordinate the timing so we don’t overlap.

Quick ask for Sam / Julia: final attendee list (first + last name, role, and whether they need pre-read). If you can send that this afternoon we’ll finalize the invite and push the exported SOC2 checklist PDF to Julia.

Cheers,
Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
